rationale: F27 and F28 are independent features that can be planned and executed in parallel. F27 fixes currency conversion, adds flags, exchange rate display, and diagnoses missing prices. F28 adds language-aware card names, updates seed user data, and adds name_pt to movers. Both build on stable F18/F22/F24 infrastructure. Risk is low: no new external dependencies, no schema migrations, no destructive changes.
